d: An inquiry into Uttar Pradesh’s electoral rolls found 13 entries bearing the name Vikas Yadav in the Azamgarh Assembly constituency. Following Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav’s allegations, the Chief Electoral Officer has ordered departmental proceedings against three election officials and action against five Booth Level Officers and a computer assistant. The Azamgarh District Election Officer has also been directed to review voter lists across all Assembly constituencies in the district. The action follows a separate inquiry into 10,470 irregular entries in Pilibhit Sadar.
